en: A vintage monochrome postcard showing a long row of ornate multi‑story residential buildings along a street. The leftmost corner building has a small tower-like roof and decorative window surrounds. Several people, including women and children, stand or walk on the sidewalk in front. A streetlamp is visible in the foreground on the right, and trees frame the scene. At the top of the card, in red print, is the caption identifying the town and street.
